patch_description: This approach replaces repeated neighborhood enumeration with a small evolutionary search. It seeds a diverse population from energy-ranked repaired QAOA samples, then generates candidates by recombining two valid networks and applying random degree-preserving switches. A lightweight surrogate screen chooses which offspring deserve LP calls, while a temperature-based acceptance rule lets the population explore beyond strict improvements. A modest random-start quota hedges against QAOA pools that happen to be weak.
